summary.text: Lonnie Hosey is a Democratic state representative from Barnwell who has represented South Carolina House District 91 since 1999 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A retired university administrator and Marine Corps veteran, he serves on the Ways and Means Committee and faces Republican Daniel Alexander in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Lonnie Hosey earned an A.A. from Voorhees College in 1975 and a B.S. in 1978, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from June 1966 to August 1969, according to the House member page.

Ballotpedia reports that he worked as a machine operator at Barnwell Mills from 1969 to 1973, as a recruiter for Voorhees College from 1978 to 1986, and in recruitment and education technology services at South Carolina State University from 1986.
The House page lists him as chairman of the Barnwell County Democratic Party beginning in 1994 and a past grand master of the Prince Hall Masons of South Carolina.
Hosey has served in the South Carolina House of Representatives since June 1, 1999, and his committee assignment is Ways and Means, according to the House member page.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a commissioner of the Barnwell County Election Committee from 1984 to 1998.
